title: Release controller State during fresh retained-audio policy admission
implementation: Only audio with an original Retained consumer check, explicitly retained target scene stamp, no data message and no held control invocation uses the detached State interval. Initial/current-gate and non-audio/data/held paths retain their existing locking and admission semantics.

Capture current exact port/permission/model revision and original credential snapshot under immediate State custody, release State for fresh installed policy and file admission, then immediately reacquire State. Any stream revision change, including pause/resume back to the same permission, or credential snapshot drift refuses the old callback. Current port pointer, closed/shutdown/permission, model binding, route ticket and original retained consumer/scene stamps are rechecked before delivery.

Every attempt still performs fresh current authorization. No NativeMediaRead or grant is cached across packets. A busy initial/final State probe returns NotReady, dropping any newly acquired lease before the existing bounded retry waits. Original queued frame200ms age and cancellation are unchanged.

Four new controlled cases cover actual decoded delivery with State free inside policy; model pause/resume, credential revision, closure, actual port retirement and shutdown while the callback runs; immediate initial-State refusal; and final-State contention releasing fresh policy readers before the owner releases its mutex. Two reversible callback cases require fresh later decoded delivery to recover.
